description: Build the HTML embed snippet for a video with the chosen player options (autoplay, muted, loop, controls, corner radius, fullscreen, responsive or fixed size). The snippet keeps the video's own aspect ratio (16:9 when its size is unknown). Also returns the bare iframe URL, the player and share links, and the direct HLS stream link (hls_url, for third-party players and channel tools that take a .m3u8 rather than an iframe) when available, else hls_status and hls_reason explaining what is missing. In urls, share (/player/) is the public link to give out and embed_iframe the embed URL; manage (/video/) is the owner's own editing page, sign-in required, and anyone else opening it is sent to the player page — never hand it out as a share link.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment inside the host page.

autoplay.description: Start playing on load (browsers require muted for this to work).

corner_radius.description: Corner radius in pixels; 0 for square corners.

height.description: Fixed height in pixels (only when responsive is false). Omit it to get the width at the video's own aspect ratio (315 for 560 at 16:9).

responsive.description: True for a fluid embed that fills its container at the video's own aspect ratio; false for a fixed pixel size.

video_id.description: The video's public id (from list_videos / get_video).

width.description: Fixed width in pixels (only when responsive is false).
